messages.subject: Question about regionCounts cov.base ?
parts:
Hi Altuna,
The User guide about parameter "cov.base" of function regionCounts makes me confused.
Here is the original description about cov.base:
number minimum bases covered per region (Default:0). Only regions with base coverage above this threshold are returned.
Does this mean that if I set cov.base = 1, only regions containing at least 2 CpGs are returned ? If it is, then what does minimum bases covered per region mean ?

Thanks!
XInlei Hu

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Question about regionCounts cov.base ?
parts:
Does this mean that if I set cov.base = 1, only regions containing at least 2 CpGs are returned ? 
If it is, then what does minimum bases covered per region mean ?

I think you understood almost correctly. I think if cov.base=1, then every region that has at least 1
CpG covered will be returned. Setting that to 0 has the same effect with setting that to 1, because we assume people will read files that contain CpGs with some read coverage. Setting cov.bases=2, will return only regions that has at least 2 CpGs covered. 

https://github.com/al2na/methylKit/blob/master/R/regionalize.R#L136
 
Thanks!
XInlei Hu
